package.description: Git identity manager - never commit with the wrong identity again

en-US.description: Git identity manager - never commit with the wrong identity again
en-US.longDescription:
gitch helps you manage multiple Git identities (email, name, SSH keys, GPG keys).
Features:
- Switch between identities instantly
- Auto-switching based on repository rules
- SSH key management per identity
- GPG signing key support
- Shell prompt integration
